name: Quiz Rush
tagline: Know it. Tap it. Climb the podium.
description: A fast house quiz with four shape buttons, speed points and streak bonuses. Pick a pack, race the clock, then see the room's answers and the leaderboard. Questions appear on your phone when there is no TV.
howToPlay: Read the question and match your answer to its shape. Tap once to lock it in.
Correct answers earn 500–1000 speed points. Streaks add up to 500 bonus points.
After each answer reveal, climb the leaderboard. Most points after the last question wins.
